facts.title: Vegan Sweet Potato, Kale and Chickpea Soup
ingredients: 1 pound sweet potatoes (2 small to medium or 1 large), peeled and diced (about 3 cups)
¼ teaspoon salt, more to taste
1 cup uncooked farro, rinsed** (or 3 cups cooked whole grains, like wheat berries, spelt berries or kamut)
1 can (15 ounces) chickpeas, rinsed and drained, or 1 ½ cups cooked chickpeas
½ bunch of kale (4 ounces), chopped (about 3 cups)
¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
